prompts.label: Part A · 第 47 题
prompts.prompt: Suppose you are going to study abroad and share an apartment with John, a local student. Write him an email to 1) tell him about your living habits, and 2) ask for advice about living there. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name. Use “Zhang Wei” instead. Do not write your address.
